description: This Java class handles the rejection of recurring deposit account applications in the system. It implements a command handler that processes rejection commands by invoking the relevant service method.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountApplicationRejectedCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles command to reject recurring deposit account applications by delegating to the platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the rejection command by calling the platform service's rejectApplication method with the command's entity ID, the command object, and the deposit account type.
